response.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_duration, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 AND rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating) SELECT AVG(avg_duration) AS avg_rental_duration, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_rate_to_cost_ratio FROM per_rating;

assumptions.assumption: 'Pricier-to-replace' means replacement_cost strictly greater than 20.99; a film at exactly 20.99 is excluded.

The ratio is computed per film (rental_rate / replacement_cost), averaged within each rating, and then the per-rating averages are averaged without weighting, as the request specifies. Films with a NULL rating are excluded. No column in the filtered rows is NULL, so AVG ignores no values.

alternatives.interpretation: Return the per-rating rows (average rental_duration and average rate-to-cost ratio for each rating) instead of the single summary row.
alternatives.sql: SELECT rating, AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_rental_duration, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_rate_to_cost_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99 AND rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating ORDER BY rating;

alternatives.interpretation: Treat 20.99 as inclusive ('at or above the cutoff'), so films with replacement_cost equal to 20.99 are also included.
